sections.title: Identity and form
sections.text: The Capsella entry represents Capsella bursa-pastoris, shepherd's purse, rather than the whole genus. This variable annual is usually about 10–60 cm tall, with a basal rosette, tiny white four-petalled flowers and distinctive heart-shaped silicles about 4–9 mm long.

sections.title: Food and image
sections.text: Young leaves, shoots and seeds are reported as food in botanical references; no broad safety advice is implied. The plate's rosette, small white flowers and inverted-heart seed pods match the species.
